3b nominated the TURN pair although 3a shows a direct srflx path works on the same networks. Cause (forge-webrtc transport.rs, also at forge HEAD): the controlling agent nominates the first pair that succeeds ("regular nomination of the first valid pair"); a relay↔relay pair needs no hole punch, so it can succeed before the srflx pair, and before the peer has even trickled its srflx candidate. RFC 8445 §8.1.1 lets checks continue and nominates the best valid pair.
